title: wifi.json
description: Saved WiFi networks, written by WifiCredentialStore (src/WifiCredentialStore.cpp) to /.crosspoint/wifi.json. Files missing the password integrity fields, or holding a legacy plaintext password, are accepted and rewritten in the current shape.

lastConnectedSsid.description: SSID of the most recently connected network; empty when none.

credentials.description: Entries past MAX_NETWORKS (8) are ignored on load.

password_obf.description: Password XORed with a key derived from the device MAC address, then base64-encoded. Only decodable on the device that wrote it.

password_len.description: Decoded password length in bytes. A mismatch after decoding discards the entry.

password_crc32.description: CRC-32 of the decoded password. A mismatch discards the entry.

password.description: Legacy plaintext password, read only when password_obf is absent or undecodable.
